atoms.b: A parallelogram is a quadrilateral in which opposite sides are ((++parallel not_parallel)) and of ((++equal unequal)) length.
You can cut a parallelogram and put it back together again to make a rectangle. If you cut off a right-angled ((++triangle square)) on the right side and put it back on the left, you get a rectangle.
By multiplying the base (𝘣) by the ((++height width)) (𝘩), you get the area of the rectangle: A = b * h. This area is ((++the_same different)) as that of the parallelogram.
